category_title: Nonverbal students with ASD who engage in repetitive tapping or premature screen advancing during iPad-based instruction
minimal_context: The student is using the Speech with Milo app on an iPad in a special day school classroom to learn prepositions.
dialogue:
TUTOR: Here is the Speech with Milo app on the iPad. Touch Milo the mouse.

STUDENT: (Touches Milo the mouse on the iPad screen without speaking.)

TUTOR: Listen to the word.

STUDENT: (Listens to the preposition named by the app.)

TUTOR: Now watch what Milo does.

STUDENT: (Advances the screen before Milo demonstrated the preposition, preventing any opportunity for preposition learning to occur.)

options.A: Terminating the demands and removing the iPad for 10 seconds.
options.B: Modeling how to use the Speech with Milo app on the iPad.
options.C: Ignoring all undesirable behaviors exhibited by the student during the activity.
options.D: Smiling at the student's accomplishment and gently congratulating him during the activity.
